photos.subject: An Indigenous village in the Amazon rainforest, in a clearing right beside a river, with its houses and the forest all around
photos.pedagogical_constraint: This is the village the lesson starts from and comes back to: the river must be right beside the houses, because the class is asked why the village was built there.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children see that people live in the rainforest, in a village beside a river, and use it to think about what a family would need and where it could come from.
load_bearing_evidence: a river right beside the village
photos.fallback_note: A made picture would invent how a real Indigenous community lives, which is the stereotype this lesson works against; without a real photograph the slides teach from the words.

photos.subject: Indigenous people of the Amazon in their own village today, on an ordinary day, for example a family together or children by the river
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Shown on the word card for Indigenous peoples: real people living their own everyday lives today, not people posed in costume for visitors.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children see that Indigenous peoples are real people who live in the Amazon now.
load_bearing_evidence: an everyday scene in their own village
photos.fallback_note: A made picture of Indigenous people would invent how a real people look and live; without a real photograph the card shows the word on its own.

photos.subject: The city of Manaus in Brazil, in the middle of the Amazon rainforest, seen from above with its tall buildings and the wide river beside it
photos.pedagogical_constraint: This shows that people also live in a big city in the rainforest, so it must look like a large modern city.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children see that not everyone in the Amazon lives in a village: some live in towns and in this big city.
load_bearing_evidence: many tall buildings of a large city
a wide river beside the city
photos.fallback_note: A made Manaus would be a lie about a real city; without a real photograph the slide says it in words beside the village.

photos.subject: A wooden canoe or small boat with people travelling along a river in the Amazon rainforest, with forest on both banks
photos.pedagogical_constraint: This shows the river being used as a road through the forest, so the boat must be travelling along the river with forest on the banks.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children see that people travel by boat along the river because there are no roads through the forest.
load_bearing_evidence: a canoe or small boat on a river

generation_prompt.physical_state: A long wooden canoe with two people paddling along a wide brown river, thick green rainforest on both banks, daylight.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A wide view of the river with the canoe clearly visible in the middle distance and the people small.

photos.subject: A person fishing with a net or a line from a canoe or the bank of a river in the Amazon rainforest
photos.pedagogical_constraint: This shows the river giving the village its food, so the fishing must be clear.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children see that people catch fish in the river to eat.
load_bearing_evidence: a person fishing with a net or a line

generation_prompt.physical_state: A person standing in a canoe throwing a round fishing net over a calm brown river, with rainforest on the bank behind, daylight.
must_avoid: a fishing boat with an engine filling the frame
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A wide view with the person small and the net clearly visible over the water.

photos.subject: The Amazon rainforest seen from high above: thick, unbroken forest with one river winding through it, and no village, roads or clearings
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Two places are marked on it, one on the river bank and one deep in the trees, so it needs wide areas of forest a long way from the river, and no houses, roads or clearings that would decide the answer.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children judge where a family should build a home from where the river is.
load_bearing_evidence: thick unbroken rainforest seen from above
large areas of forest well away from the river

generation_prompt.physical_state: Thick green rainforest seen from high above, with a single brown river winding across part of the picture and wide stretches of unbroken forest away from it.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A top-down aerial view, landscape, with the river crossing one side and plenty of forest on the other.

photos.subject: A house in an Amazon rainforest village with wooden posts and a roof made of palm leaves
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The board says the posts are tree trunks and the roof is woven palm leaves, so both must be clear.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children see that a home is built from wood and leaves from the forest around it.
load_bearing_evidence: a roof made of dried palm leaves

generation_prompt.physical_state: A single house with a thick roof of dried palm leaves on wooden posts, standing in a clearing with rainforest trees behind, daylight.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: The whole house in view, from the side, with the roof and posts clear.

photos.subject: A Brazil nut pod cracked open, showing the Brazil nuts packed inside
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The board says the pods fall from the tall trees and people collect the nuts inside, so the nuts inside must show.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children see the hard pod and the nuts people collect from it.

generation_prompt.physical_state: A round brown woody Brazil nut pod broken open on the forest floor, with the nuts in their shells packed inside.
must_avoid: nuts in a shop bag or packet
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A close-up of the open pod, filling most of the frame.

photos.subject: Leafy green plants growing on the floor of the Amazon rainforest, the kind of plants people pick
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Shown beside the line about making medicine from plants: just plants growing in the forest, with no bottles, pills or a shop.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children see the forest plants that Indigenous peoples know how to make medicine from.
load_bearing_evidence: leafy green rainforest plants, close up

generation_prompt.physical_state: Close-up of leafy green plants with large leaves growing on a damp, shady rainforest floor.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A close view of the plants filling the frame.

photos.subject: A different Indigenous village in the Amazon rainforest beside a river, seen from the river or from above, with its houses, the river bank and the forest behind
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Children describe how this village uses the rainforest from what they can see, so the river must be right beside the houses and the forest must be in view; it must be a different village from the one at the start of the lesson.
photos.teaching_requirement: Children describe how a village they have not seen uses the river and the forest, pointing at what the photograph shows.
load_bearing_evidence: a river right beside the houses
rainforest around or behind the village
photos.fallback_note: A made picture would invent how a real Indigenous community lives; without a real photograph the task is answered from what the lesson taught and the steps.
